g.text: fworker refactor: phases and their gates (each phase: several PRs, behind flags, in the tdd gateway)
R0 Prerequisites and safety
aisf off board 679; acting gateway min 1 replica; PR #253 merged
v1 fixes (fencing, durable budgets, day budget, rev check); quick wins;
flow metrics in the state comment; golden-write harness
gate: Tier 1 green; a tdd batch no slower
R1 Structure and seams, all v1
projects (host name kept); first Domain ports + parity tests
S1 to S6 on v1; answers return posted journal lines; verb inventory
gate: golden writes identical; per-item event sequences unchanged
R2 Wolverine host, inert
Azure SQL (acting gateway), Solo mode on the lease holder,
background storage setup; OpenTelemetry; dead-letter admin
shadow history of every journal line and event; SQL Server in CI
gate: 7 days; every posted line has a history row;
acts with the database stopped; uat/prod start without one
R3 Durable side effects
runtime start/stop with result messages, runbook runs,
journal via the journal verb, Copilot reservation; classified errors
gate: no lost or duplicated line, start or stop, with a kill
R4 Durable ingress and board reconciler
webhooks and the Octopus watcher into the inbox; correlation map;
board reconciler (or projects_v2_item delivery)
gate: every board change of a batch has its event
R5 DeliveryTrainSaga
ItemMerged(commit, gates) from v1; shadow, then authoritative
with no Sign-off pending; v1 promotion off at the same moment
gate: zero shadow difference over 3 releases; one batch to prod
R6 Docs plan
replenish-marker + Auto Merge items; separate runtime, offered only to its sessions;
direct merge by the saga; every v1 path skips or forwards v2 items
gate: 8 docs items to Done on v2; v1 unaffected on its own slots
R7 Feature plan
full scheduler (v1 asks via S6); merge moved into C# and the train;
delivery-speed section 5; smoke evidence; approved cross-repo pieces
gate: an 8-item code batch to prod on v2, against the baseline
R8 Incidents
IncidentSaga, hotfix plan, alert webhooks, rollback via the train
gate: a staged incident in tdd, end to end
R9 Retire v1
QC ported; every verb to its destination (inventory table);
transcripts to the database; Balanced mode; session mailbox
remove the sweep engine, server rule scripts, lease, snapshot
gate: no v1 item; Tier 1 green with every capability on v2
